articles.title: WFP Lebanon Country Brief, October 2026
articles.description: Please refer to the attached file. IN NUMBERS 402,300 people assisted in September (52% female) 465 mt food distributed in September USD 9.8 M cash transferred in September USD 125.3 M required in the next six months (October 2026 – March 2027) KEY HIGHLIGHTS WFP is preparing to launch a two-month mixed modality assistance pilot for recently displaced Syrian households in collective shelters in Jabal Mohsen in Tripoli. The Logistics and Telecommunications Cluster facilitated seven convoys to hard-to-reach locations in South Lebanon and supported two regional Jordan-Lebanon convoys. WFP and UNHCR Representatives undertook a high-level advocacy mission to Berlin, engaging Members of Parliament, BMZ, GFFO and key policy stakeholders. The mission reinforced the need for sustained international support to Lebanon, spanning humanitarian funding, social protection and capacity strengthening.
